This battery comes with a 2 year non-transferable warranty. Watt Hours: 4536 Wh IP Rating: IP65 Weight: 19.65 kg Peak Power: 28 kW BMS Rating: 400 A Amp Hours: 63ah

name: QS8 Harness Upgrade for LBX Battery Upgrade
description: This new upgraded QS8 SurRon Light Bee Battery to Controller Harness allows you to safely run more power without melting your battery terminals or the OEM wires. Note, that you will need to have the ability to solder the battery terminal plug on without blowing yourself up. EBMX specifically disclaim we are not responsible for user installation errors. Please message us if you are in Australia and would like to drop or freight your battery to us and we can install the battery and terminal at an extra fee.

name: More Poweeer Electric 52V 17.5Ah Jumbo Shark Battery with 50A BMS Capable of up to 4kW of Power
description: This pack is the highest power & best 52V pack available in Australia. Made with Panasonic NCR18650GA 3500mah cells. It has a 50A BMS  with O2 IC. 35cm discharge wires with XT90 female connector. It also comes with a 58.8V 4A aluminium charger Do not confuse this battery option with cheaper options. If you want to run a 4kw+ bike like SEM Venom or high power E-bike you will need a battery capable of 50A BMS or the battery wont work across the entire battery range. 14S5P cell configuration 910 Wh Battery charger included 367L 95W 125H Docking station 2 keys Weight 4.87 KG 4 mounting slots to connect to bike frame Discharge cable with micro Anderson connectors Continuous discharge 50A Battery Management System (BMS) Managing 12 months warranty

name: Ultra Bee 22S (81v 76ah) Version 4 High Power Battery Kit
description: If you already own an Ultra Bee, or are thinking about buying one, this bundle is the very best way to upgrade the power on your Ultra Bee.  These batteries come with a two year non-transferable warranty. 88V76Ah Weight :26.5kg  Peak Power: 53kW Nominal capacity: 6688Wh Dimensions (mm):225mm x 177mm x 373mm IP65 Rating High Power Harness The Bundle Includes: 81v (22S) 76Ah High Power Version 4 Battery 15A Charger* Custom Moulded Lid for Larger Battery *Please note, if you purchase an Ultra Bee  22S Battery  this is fitted with a 15A Plug (rather than a standard 10A plug). This is due to the charger needing to draw up to 11A. In order to use the charger, you will need a 15Amp outlet. If you do not have a 15A outlet, you can get an adaptor from any Electrical Hardware Store or Online which will adapt your 10A outlet to 15A. Please be aware, that while using this solution is effective there is a very low possibility (depending on the RCD’s or RCBO’s in your house, and the wiring you have), this charger could possibly trip your fuse breakers (as it is drawing slightly more than 10a). If you specifically do not want the 15amp plug then please in notes let us know and we will custom fit a 10amp plug. This will mean you cannot have the fast charger and your battery will take around 7 hours from zero to 100%.

name: 72V 42 Ah Race Battery LBX V5 (Compatible with SurRon Light Bee Only) – Includes Charger
description: Our new V5 high power Race Series SurRon LightBee Battery is a BEAST Power upgrade for your bike. This is Best of the Best! It has a new look with injection molded Top and QS8 receptacle harness and new Gen 5 Display. This is a 72v 42ah Battery capable of peak 28kW power (360a peak discharge for 51 seconds until cut off on mosfet temp protection. Voltage drop of 4.4 volts.) 15kW continuous at 200A discharge run for 4 minutes and 16 second continuous load until cut off on mosfet temp protection. Voltage drop of 2.8v. This is a full plug and play kit that includes thicker wires and QS8 Connectors on the battery-side, custom made harness to replace the air switch. Battery comes with an extended battery clip to enable it to fit into a SurRon Light Bee without seat extenders. These batteries come with a two year non-transferable warranty.  Please note: We recommend to get the best operation power pairing this battery with the  EBMX X-9000 Controller. We cannot guarantee that this battery will be compatible with other third party controllers.

name: 22S (81v) Battery Charger
description: Please note, if you purchase an SurRon Ultra Bee or Talaria Sting 81V (22S) Battery, this charger is fitted with a 15Amp Plug (rather than a standard 10A plug). This has been done due to the higher voltage of the charger needing to draw up to 11 amps. This means that in order to use the charger, you will need a 15Amp outlet/ If you do not have a 15A outlet, you can get an adaptor from any Electrical Hardware Store or Online which will adapt your 10A outlet to 15A. Please be aware, that while using this solution is effective, there is a very low possibility (depending on the RCD’s or RCBO’s in your house, and the wiring you have), this charger could possibly trip your fuse breakers (as it is drawing just slightly more than 10a). If you specifically do not want the 15amp plug then please in notes let us know and we will custom fit a 10amp plug. This will mean you cannot have the fast charger and your battery will take around 7 hours from zero to 100%.

name: 72v 20a Battery Fast Charger
description: These 72v 20a Fast Chargers are designed to work with the MPE 72v Range of Batteries. These chargers are not compatible with the 60v OEM SurRon Light Bee Battery or any of the 60v MPE Range of Batteries.

name: OEM 60v SurRon X/L1E Charger
description: These Stock SurRon Light Bee Chargers are available for purchase to replace damaged or lost chargers, or as a spare charger. These are compatible with the 60v SurRon Light Bee X Batteries, SurRon Light Bee L1E Batteries, and the EBMX 60v 53ah and EBMX 60v 65ah Batteries. This will not work with any non-60v battery and we cannot guarantee it will work with any battery not specified above.
